notes.title: Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.1.1. released
notes.content:
Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.1.1 is now available.
The main contents of the update are as follows


[Bug Fixes]
Fixed a problem in which a pop-up window would appear incorrectly in "Going for a Walk".
Fixed a problem in which a dialog box would appear prompting the user to change the game mode each time an episode was completed under certain conditions.

notes.title: Piano at 5 a.m. Additional Post-Ending Content
notes.content:
In ver1.1.0,
The post-ending content "Going for a Walk" has been added.


In "Going for a Walk," you can continue strolling leisurely forever with no time limit.
Please enjoy the peaceful time.

We have also added a "shopping" feature that allows you to purchase items of your choice.
You can purchase any item you wish using the "ten-yen coin" that you can sometimes get from "going for a walk".

*"Going for a Walk" and "Shopping" will be opened after all endings are completed.


Thank you for your continued support of "Piano at 5 a.m.".

notes.title: Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.1.0 released
notes.content:
Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.1.0 is now available.
The main contents of the update are as follows


[Contents]
The post-ending content "Going for a walk" has been added.
　This content allows users to continue strolling leisurely forever without time limit.
　The "Going for a Walk" will be opened after all endings have been completed.
A new post-ending content "Shopping" has been added.
　You can purchase any item with "ten-yen coins" obtained from "Going for a Walk".
　Shopping" will be opened after all endings are completed.


[Additional specifications]
Added a specification that suggests changing the game mode when the game is over three times in the "GAME" game mode.


[Bug fixes]
Fixed a problem in which the detail window would not disappear in some cases.
Fixed a problem in which the item's effect was triggered by making certain selections when acquiring the item.


[Adjustments]
Some text has been adjusted.

notes.title: Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.0.3 released
notes.content:
Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.0.3 is now available.
The main contents of the update are as follows


[Bug Fixes]
Fixed an issue where playing back an episode from the gallery would allow the user to proceed to a different ending.

[Adjustment]
Parameter increases/decreases for some events have been adjusted.
Adjusted the drop rate of some items.
Some texts were adjusted.

notes.title: Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.0.2 released
notes.content:
Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.0.2 is now available.
The main contents of the update are as follows


[Adjustments]
The effects of almost all items were revised upward.
The scenario branching by game mode is no longer generated.

notes.title: Piano at 5 A.M. Release Announcement & Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
"Piano at 5 A.M." was released on May 2, 2023.
Please enjoy the quiet world like a short story.
We are looking forward to your review.


We would like to inform you about our future updates.
We will continue to fix bugs and make adjustments based on reports from our players for a while.
We would appreciate your feedback via message boards, Twitter, etc.

We are also planning to add a "stroll mode (tentative name)" in the near future, which will remove the "until 8:00 a.m." limit and allow you to play leisurely forever.
Please look forward to it. (The "Strolling Mode (tentative name)" will be opened only after the ending.)


Thank you for your continued support for "Piano at 5:00 a.m.".

notes.title: Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.0.1 released
notes.content:
Piano at 5 a.m. ver1.0.1 is now available.
The main contents of the update are as follows


[ADJUSTMENT]
The game mode "NORMAL" has been changed to "GAME".
　The difficulty level of the game has not been changed.
Some texts were adjusted.
